steps.note: N0.1 states the eight-row schedule changes the target by (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values a,c, quoting line 748 'Rows 6 and 7 restore c,a'; N0's method also has each invocation restore the scratch values.
N0.2 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero or two, and coefficient one for T=S.
N0.3 states central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling for intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
N0.4 and N0's method give the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with every scratch wire restored.

The plan only says in L0's method that each edge's orthogonal residual is 'read from a table'; no residual or dimension entry of the table is stated (L0.4 gives only that edges join comparable labels).
L0.3 has the nesting P(x)<t_X> inside P(x)t_Y-perp from t_X perp t_Y, but never the edge 2->5 residual, the complement <t_X,t_Y>-perp, or its dimension h-2.
L0.4 gives center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h; R0.1 gives telescoping with sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N; R0.2 gives L=Ich and absolute total Wm-2N+2L.
L0.5 (and P0.4) only assert that nonzero binary residuals have orthonormal bases; nondegeneracy, nonalternating (norm-one vector) and absorbing alternating planes are not stated.
R0.3 states the exact values L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539.
P0.1 gives additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and P0.2 gives q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x] (negated on a decreasing edge).
P0.3 states wt(v) is odd, the phase i^(eps[v.x]) expansion, and H diag(1,-1) H = X giving the kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse.
The plan counts one kernel per residual vector but never says that on k columns each residual vector gives one tensored factor K^(tensor k); no k-column tensoring appears.

P0.6 gives frames I and C^(tensor m) for zero/full labels and C^-1 on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a); P0.7 gives C=iZC^-1Z with Z_{a,k} before and i^(27k)Z_{a,k} after; P0.8 gives negating the X outputs.
R0 states L<N/2 so the total is strictly below Wm, B0.3 states deficit N-2L_b>0 because L_b<N/2, and R0.3 states both ratios are below 1/2.
The plan never gives the value eta_b = 339/22587335000000 (B0.5 only says the deficits exceed 20*2^-50).
The plan never gives the value eta_c = 73/19906842167500.
B0.5 states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50 and m<2^20, so m^(1-2^-50) > m(1-20*2^-50) > m(1-eta), hence s/W < m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 (uses m<2^20 for log m<20, same content).
T0's method and T0.1-T0.3 give the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations, repeating on active indices, and exactly a ones in Pi.
MS0.1 chooses the factorizations once and a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator and diagonal-entry numerator so identities specialize and triangular factors stay invertible.
MS0.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier coordinates still holding original values.
MS0.4 realizes each one of Pi by D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with exactly one interchange, so a interchanges in all.
E (G0.1), B via (s+E)x=Bx (G0.2), C_0 and C_1>=nu+3 (G0.3) and Delta (G0) appear, but nu is never defined (min j with m^j>=B, nu=11) and C_1=max{20,nu+3} is not stated; incomplete, so absent.

G0.1 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf with E=64(W+m+1)^3 over a concatenated invocation, noting s rather than s/W; the explicit per-invocation operation count 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E is not spelled out.
G0.2 gives sx+E<=Bx, B^(k+1)<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^(nu+1); G0.3 gives total depth <128mB^2 d^(nu+3) <= C_0 d^(C_1).
G0.4 gives values at depth j in 2^-(p+j)Z[i] with modulus at most 2^j; G0 states p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact; G0.5 gives epsilon*C_1<1 implying Delta=o(p).
B0x.1 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays and truncation toward zero errs by less than sqrt2 * 2^-p.

summary: Present: B1-B4, L3, L5, P1, P2, P4, R1, R4, M1-M4, S2-S5 (19 of 26). Absent: L1 (residual table named but not given), L2 (only the nesting from t_X perp t_Y, no complement or dimension h-2), L4 (orthonormal-basis result asserted without the nonalternating/absorption argument), P3 (no k-column tensoring), R2 and R3 (exact eta values not stated), S1 (nu and C_1 definitions missing). No sub-step contradicts the paper.
